2025-02-15
Claim opened after the insured reported a sdieswipe that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. The
claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through that office.
2025-02-16
Police report obtained. It places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene and records the other driver's account, which
matches the insured's description of the lane change.
2025-03-02
Photographs from the scene and statements from two independent witnesses were collected. Both witnesses
describe the same sequence of events, and the other driver has confirmed the account without qualification.
2025-06-14
Damage to the claimant's vehicle was inspected. It is mostly confined to the side panels and mirror, which is
consistent with the impact described, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is on record.
2025-06-19
Claimant reported a back strain and began treatment through counsel's referral. The injury is consistent in type and
force with a side impact of this kind, and no prior injury to the same area appears in our records.
2025-07-11
A neighbor contacted the office saying the vehicle looked damaged a few weeks before the reported loss. This is a
secondhand recollection with no supporting photos or records, and it has been noted for follow-up without changing
the current assessment.
2025-09-23
Each conversation with the claimant, including the recorded statement, has given the same account of the accident.
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, and the medical file is being reviewed for the
reasons.
2025-10-03
The driver is confirmed as a named driver on the policy, and covergae applies. Remaining open items are the medical
review and the neighbor's statement, and the file will be updated when counsel responds to the outstanding requests.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
